question: What ritual purpose is associated with the form having the splendor of heated gold?
premises: The form has the splendor of heated gold.
It is the cause of agitation of cities and so forth.
Its appearance is linked to that effect.
inference: The golden-splendor form is used as the cause for agitating cities and similar purposes.
plain_english: Having the splendor of heated gold, it is the cause of agitating cities and so forth.
